tex_content.html:
Definition
[The slice chart of a level set]

↗ lem:adapted-chart-scalar-affine

With $M$, $f$, $c$ as above and $y \in f^{-1}(c)$, let $G$ be an adapted chart at $y$ as in Lemma 12. Since $df_y \neq 0$, the kernel $\ker df_y$ is a hyperplane in the $(n+1)$-dimensional model space, so it has dimension $n$; fix a linear isomorphism $\iota : \mathbb {R}^n \to \ker df_y$ and let $\pi $ be the projection onto $\ker df_y$ along any vector $e$ with $df_y(e) = 1$, read in the coordinates $\iota $. The slice chart of $f^{-1}(c)$ at $y$ is the map \[ x \longmapsto \pi \bigl(G(\kappa (x)) - \kappa (y)\bigr), \] defined for $x \in f^{-1}(c)$ in the domain of $G \circ \kappa $, with inverse $z \mapsto \kappa ^{-1}(G^{-1}(\kappa (y) + \iota (z)))$.
